stories.detail: 3-pointer on hole 17, 1-pointer on hole 18

stories.detail: 7 twos in a row on holes 12-18 - reliable, consistent, zero drama

stories.detail: 3-pointers on holes 17 & 18 - this is momentum

stories.title: Not Done Yet
stories.detail: Wipe on hole 17, 3-pointer on hole 18 - that's better

stories.detail: A run of 9 straight scoring holes - smooth sailing

stories.detail: 3-pointer straight into a 1-pointer on holes 17 & 18

stories.detail: 5 twos in a row on holes 14-18 - not a bad thing, actually

stories.title: Settling In
stories.detail: 4 twos in a row on holes 15-18 - starting to look comfortable

stories.title: Big-Dog Territory
stories.detail: 3-pointers on 2 of the par 5s - bombing them and cashing in

stories.detail: 5 straight two-pointers on holes 14-18

stories.detail: Hit every outcome on the card - the golf round as a show bag

stories.detail: 4 twos on the bounce on holes 13-16

stories.detail: 4 wipes from 18 holes - the scorecard is mostly fresh air

stories.detail: Front nine 19, back nine 5 - the tank hit empty

comingLast.roast: deadlocked with Holle for the double blue - the bar has picked sides
on 20 with 3 to play - even the cart girl knows the equation
tied with O'Connell - two men, two blue balls, maths pending
1 above O'Connell from the clubhouse - it never felt so thin from a chair
in with a 3-point moat - drawbridge stuck halfway up
finished 3 above the blue line - toasting every point O'Connell does not score
above the blue balls by 3 - margin thinner than the clubhouse gravy
done and dangling 4 above the blue balls - do not jinx it
safe-ish by 5 - the blue balls have come back from further
